assertion_analysis.failure_condition: all(before.values()) fails if the fixture made no installed rows for either retired-day tier.
rebuild_job_tiers is True fails if rebuild refuses the present files.
after == before[path] fails if any retired-day minute or hour line is dropped, changed, or reordered; the declared interval mutation does fail it.
len(reports) == 2 fails if a pre-apply fault stops the ingest loop before two ticks complete.
sample_count > 0 fails if the loop completes without indexing the fixture record.
last_report.error is not None fails if the pass hides a manifest, rename, or scheduler fault.
raw.exists() fails if a fault raised before apply still deletes the raw file.
fault in caplog.text fails if the pass contains a fault without logging its type.
len(reports) == 2 fails if a vacuum lock stops the ingest loop.
not raw.exists() fails if a vacuum lock prevents the already-applied retirement.
last_report.removed == (raw,) fails if the report omits the file actually removed.
vacuum_owed is True fails if a failed vacuum loses the debt.
next_report.removed == () fails if the retry pass retires a file despite the fixture having none left.
next_report.vacuum_owed is False fails if a successful retry does not clear the debt.
len(attempts) == 2 fails if the empty next pass omits the vacuum retry or repeats it.
forget([raw]) == 1 fails if the same-path source is not selected for deletion.
sample_count == 0 fails if same-path sample rows survive forget.
sample_count == 1 fails if reingesting the fixture after forget does not restore one sample.
sample_count == 0 fails if tier deselection does not remove the same-path sample.
calls == [str(raw), str(raw)] fails if either operation bypasses the shared helper, although it does not cover a source renamed after indexing.

findings.text: blocking: _delete_source_rows requires sample.path to equal source.path, but a roll inserts the renamed source under the new path while previously indexed samples retain the old path (source insertion at line 1229, sample insertion at line 1479); forgetting the retired segment removes its source row but leaves its samples, so the subsequent vacuum cannot give their space back and the new test at tests/test_telemetry_index.py:1955 uses only an unchanged path.

follow-on: if apply_manifest removes one eligible file and raises while removing a later one, the assignment to removed at line 143 never runs; the caught exception reports no removals and schedules neither index cleanup nor vacuum for the file already deleted.
